limitations: No Digital Macaroni hands-on test was completed.
The current pricing page did not expose public Pro or Business prices in its readable page content.
A competitor article was retained only as context and did not determine the verdict.

claims.statement: Claap records meetings or short screen videos, creates transcripts and summaries, and lets teammates comment at a specific time in the recording.
Basic includes ten created videos and 300 recorded minutes in total. Pro includes unlimited recordings, 1,000 minutes monthly, and 500 AI credits monthly.
Easy recording, sharing, summaries, and time-stamped feedback are common reasons customers say Claap saves time.
Slow processing, playback delays, recording limits, and weak organization as the library grows are repeated complaints.

scoreRationale.onboarding: Recording and sharing are described as easy, though a larger workspace takes organization.
scoreRationale.product: Claap combines useful recording, summary, and feedback tools, but speed and library management can interrupt the benefit.
scoreRationale.support: Support was not tested directly and receives mixed mentions.
scoreRationale.billing: Basic is enough for a small trial. Current paid prices were not clearly displayed in readable public page content.
scoreRationale.overall: Claap is useful when a recording replaces a meeting or makes follow-up easier. It is wasteful when the team merely creates another video archive.

conflictsAndUnknowns: High ratings sit beside repeated complaints about processing speed.
No transcription accuracy, privacy, or CRM integration test was completed.
Current paid prices require confirmation in the signup flow or from sales.
